title: Fix foundation-dashboard auth state wipe on transient server errors
body: ## Problem In `foundation-dashboard.html`, when `/api/session/validate` returns a non-OK HTTP response (e.g., 500, 502, 503 from a temporary server issue), `clearCachedAuthState()` was called. This function wipes `phins_token` from **both** `localStorage` and `sessionStorage`, and also removes the `session` cache from `localStorage`. A transient server error would therefore destroy **all** auth state, which: - Affects other open tabs that rely on the same storage - Removes any recovery path, even though the session itself may be perfectly valid - Differs from the reference implementation in `dashboard.html` ## Fix Replaced the `clearCachedAuthState()` call in the non-OK HTTP response branch (line 2393) with `safeStorageRemove(localStorage, 'phins_token')`, matching the behavior in `dashboard.html`. This preserves: - The `sessionStorage` backup of `phins_token` (for other tabs / recovery) - The `session` cache in `localStorage` (for offline/degraded recovery) The `clearCachedAuthState()` call in the `info.valid === false` branch (line 2387) is left unchanged, as that represents a server-confirmed invalid session where full cleanup is appropriate. ## Verification - All 29 API integration tests pass - Change is a single-line substitution in `web_portal/static/foundation-dashboard.html`
